title: Elements exceeding limitations of conventional construction.
officialText:
When a building of otherwise con-
ventional construction contains structural elements exceeding the limits of Section 2308.2, these elements
and the supporting load path shall be designed in accordance with accepted engineering practice and the
provisions of this code.
